usageNotes: Returns the ACME sub-resource index for a specific node, listing the available child endpoints (e.g. certificate, challenge-schema) under /nodes/{node}/certificates/acme. Use this to discover what ACME operations are supported before calling more specific endpoints. No query parameters are required and any authenticated user or API token may call it.

examples.summary: List ACME sub-resources for node pve1

tips: The response is a navigation index (links with rel=child), not ACME certificate data itself — follow child hrefs to get certificate info or manage ACME settings.
Accessible to all authenticated users, including read-only API tokens, so no special privilege is needed.
The node must be reachable by the Proxmox cluster; if the node is offline, the API request will fail at the proxy layer.
